args.title: Bellwether Office — Retail returns logistics (newsletter + article + companion)
args.body:
- Newsletter: Bellwether Office's latest issue covers retail returns logistics (blog.bellwether.example/2026/returns).
- Article: Apparel return rates have reached 24%, and consolidating returns into centralized hubs cut handling cost by about a fifth.
- Companion piece (subscriber): Reselling returned goods within 10 days preserved most of the margin.
